plain_meaning: Money has come in. They have not opened the course yet.
what_we_are_trying_to_do: Get them logged in and into the first class.
what_ends_it: First login and first video watched.
momentum_matters: No. Everyone gets the same welcome.
sizeable_today: Yes. Payment date is on file for 42,414 students.

plain_meaning: Logged in, watching, still finding their feet.
what_we_are_trying_to_do: Get them to finish one full subject so the habit forms.
what_ends_it: One subject completed, or 30 days pass.
momentum_matters: Yes. This is where most drop-off starts.
sizeable_today: No. Needs the login and watch-time feed.

plain_meaning: The long middle. Working through the syllabus.
what_we_are_trying_to_do: Keep them moving at the pace the exam needs.
momentum_matters: Yes. This is the main use of momentum.
sizeable_today: No. Needs attempt on file plus watch time.

momentum_matters: Yes, but the action is the same for everyone: push mocks.
sizeable_today: Partly. Needs attempt on file. 38.5 percent have it.

plain_meaning: They sat the exam. Nobody knows the outcome yet.
typical_length: CFA about 6 to 8 weeks, CA about 2 months
what_we_are_trying_to_do: Confirm they actually sat it, and stay in touch so result day is not a cold call.

plain_meaning: They cleared. Confirmed by them, not by us.
how_a_student_lands_here: Student tells us, or a counsellor confirms.
what_we_are_trying_to_do: Sell the next level while the win is fresh.
sizeable_today: No. We do not capture results today.

plain_meaning: They did not clear. Confirmed by them.
how_a_student_lands_here: Student tells us, or a counsellor confirms.
what_we_are_trying_to_do: Get them signed up for the next attempt before they quit the qualification.
sizeable_today: No. We do not capture results today.

plain_meaning: Their exam date passed and they did not sit it.
what_we_are_trying_to_do: Find out why, and move them to a realistic attempt.
what_ends_it: They commit to a new attempt.
momentum_matters: Yes. Low momentum before the exam predicts this.

plain_meaning: Validity is over, or six months quiet with no attempt on file.
how_a_student_lands_here: Validity expiry, or 180 days of silence.
what_we_are_trying_to_do: One honest win-back, then leave them alone.
what_ends_it: They buy again, or they opt out.
sizeable_today: Yes. 27,962 students last bought over 24 months ago.
